state.background: Review a proposed simplification of measurement in shared_plan/42-happy-dom-e2e-migration-plan.md. The current plan contains extensive preflight, dedicated worktree and identity validation, discovery matching, per-gate timing and resource snapshots, multiple historical run protocols, and detailed artifact manifests. The proposed active protocol supersedes those measurement details while preserving the eight correctness/quality gates. Measurement is only a reference record of full-suite elapsed time before and after the migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Measurement purpose is limited to recording reference full-test elapsed times before and after migration; it makes no improvement-rate determination, performance pass/fail decision, or statistical claim.

Run only the full E2E test command once for baseline and once for candidate, on the same host with the same exact command, measurement start/end points, and Node/pnpm conditions; record commit identity.
Keep the existing eight gates as functional/quality acceptance checks, but do not mix their timing into the measurement or record per-gate durations.
Record only commit, command, runtime/host conditions, elapsed seconds, pass/fail, and executed test count. An incomplete run has no elapsed completion time.

Do not require a dedicated worktree, detailed preflight, inventory identity/discovery matching, individual port/fixture checks, CPU/memory/disk snapshots, a large wrapper, or per-gate/artifact manifests for measurement. Assume dependencies are already prepared and exclude dependency preparation from timing.
Because baseline has 141 tests and candidate has 139, do not interpret elapsed-time differences as performance improvement. Functional equivalence and quality are evaluated by the eight gates.
Treat the current candidate dry-run of 359.64 seconds as preliminary only, not an official measurement. Briefly retain the failed baseline wrong-inventory attempt as invalid history.

Make one run per role the active protocol; move the old three-run/six-run procedures and duplicated outdated runbooks out of the current instructions and into historical records. Organize the measurement section as purpose, procedure, record table, and interpretation limits.
knownConstraints: Source evidence is in shared_plan/42-happy-dom-e2e-migration-plan.md, especially lines 10-23, 75-93, 300-521, and 836-923; these sections currently reflect mixed active/historical timing protocols.
The eight existing gates continue to provide functional and quality verification and remain independent from the elapsed-time record.
No credentials or secrets are included in this review context. The plan and non-authentication review context are authorized for JEV submission.
verification: Confirm the active measurement instructions specify one full E2E run per role and the same command, host, start/end points, and Node/pnpm conditions.
Confirm the record schema contains only the specified minimal fields and does not require completion time for an incomplete run.
Confirm legacy repeated-run protocols are clearly historical and do not conflict with the active procedure.
Confirm the 141-versus-139 population difference and preliminary/invalid histories are represented without performance or validity overclaims.
state.outputRequirement: Return exactly one selected choice and its complete probability distribution and confidence. valid_as_defined means the proposed simplification is coherent and meets the stated criteria. For any concern, choose one mutually exclusive reason category and provide a case-specific finding, affected plan section or requirement, observed evidence from the supplied context, and a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not infer severity from the reason category or invent evidence.

plan.instructions: Is the proposed simplified measurement protocol sufficient and internally consistent with the acceptance criteria? Return the full probability distribution over these mutually exclusive choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The plan is sufficient as proposed.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A requirement conflicts with the intended simplified measurement; identify it and the needed correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A prerequisite is missing; identify the exact information needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The plan description lacks information needed to judge it; identify the missing details or evidence.
criteria.implementation_issue: The proposed procedure has an operational issue; identify the affected step, evidence, and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The proposal exceeds or falls outside the stated scope; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the categories; provide its location, evidence, and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify the missing context if possible.
